items.title: Counter Reel
items.description: Mechanical odometer, digits roll at different rates. Lower digits spin more, which is what makes it read as a drum rather than a number swap.
items.install: HFPat.counterReel(el, opts) — junction pattern-library/ into the project, then call
items.enforced: derives timing from opts.budget and self-applies all three data-layout-allow-* to nodes it builds

items.title: Rise In
items.description: Entrance from below, settles on expDecay, optional alternating tilt.
items.enforced: autoOrder sorts by offsetParent chain sum — it sorts its own order rather than trusting the caller

items.title: Drift Field
items.description: Slow linear background drift across the full duration. Fixes dead-still backgrounds, which read as broken in short pieces.

items.title: Star Pop
items.description: Rating row, staggered with overshoot. Inline SVG, no network dependency.

items.title: Copy In
items.description: Headline then sub. Spacing only, no rule or underline.

items.title: Card Pitch
items.description: Card sequence with measured spacing and distribution.
items.enforced: measures and distributes rather than accepting authored spacing

items.title: Guard Motion
items.description: Overlap guard. Throws on card-over-card overlap rather than rendering it.
items.enforced: catches card-over-card overlap closed-form and throws
